senses.sense_definition: A small to medium-sized marsupial native to Australia and New Guinea, similar to but smaller than a kangaroo.

examples.text: We saw a small <w>wallaby</w> hopping through the tall grass during our trip to Australia.
The <w>wallaby</w> is a marsupial that carries its young in a pouch.

senses.sense_definition: A member of the Australian national rugby union team.

examples.text: The <w>Wallaby</w> scored a try in the final minutes of the intense rugby match.
Every <w>Wallaby</w> played with great determination against their rivals from New Zealand.
